test_title: SSC Stenographer 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 13 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: As of March 2023, who is the Chief Election Commissioner of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajiv Kumar.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rajiv Kumar:-**

 
 
• **He is a distinguished Indian civil servant who currently serves as the 25th Chief Election Commissioner of India. **
 
• He is a highly experienced and respected public figure with a long and illustrious career spanning over four decades.
 
• Rajiv Kumar joined the Indian Administrative Service (IAS) in 1984 and served in various capacities in the Bihar/Jharkhand cadre.
 
• He has held key positions in the state and central governments.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Anup Chandra Pandey:-**

 
 
• **He is a retired Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officer of the 1984 batch belonging to the Uttar Pradesh cadre. **
 
• Pandey had also served as the Chief Secretary of the Government of Uttar Pradesh, in addition to serving as the Infrastructure and Industrial Development Commissioner of Uttar Pradesh, before retiring on 31 August 2019.
 
• He was a Member, National Green Tribunal Oversight Committee, U.P before joining Election Commission.
 
 
 
• **Sushil Chandra:-**
 
 
• **He is an esteemed Indian civil servant who served as the 24th Chief Election Commissioner of India from April 2021 to May 2022. **
 
• Prior to that, he held the position of Election Commissioner of India from February 2019 to April 2021.
 
• Throughout his illustrious career, he has made significant contributions to the Indian Revenue Service (IRS) and the Election Commission of India (ECI).
 
 
 
• **Arun Goel:-**
 
 
• **He is an accomplished Indian civil servant who currently serves as the Election Commissioner of India. **
 
• He is a highly respected and experienced administrator with a distinguished career spanning over three decades.
 
• Throughout his tenure, he has made significant contributions to various sectors, including urban development, culture, heavy industries, and election administration.
